page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout; ligatures ss read as ss (esse, desciuerint). The line break "exe-dem" is uncertain: the first part may be a ligature or abbreviation for "eæ", so "exe-dem" is marked [?]. "varijs" and "ijsdem" are printed with a j-form final i and are kept as printed. Italic words are read from the scan; "ritibus", "doctrina", "fide." and "comedat fructum pomorum tuorum" appear in italic, while "moribus" is uncertain. Show-through and edge shading on the left and right edges are not transcribed.
